ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Kai has to insert the numbers $3,4,5,6$ and 7 into the five circles of the diagram on the right in the following way: The product of the three numbers in the vertices of each triangle has to be equal to the number stated within the triangle. How big is the sum of the numbers in the vertices of the triangle with the number 168?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a diamond-shaped structure composed of five empty circles, with the positions of the circles respectively being top T, left L, center C, right R, and bottom B. The center circle is connected to the surrounding circles, forming four small triangles: the upper-left triangle T-L-C has 105 written inside, the upper-right triangle T-R-C has 84 written inside, the lower-left triangle L-B-C has 210 written inside, and the lower-right triangle R-B-C has 168 written inside. The problem asks to put 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 into the five circles, each used once, so that the product of the three vertex numbers of each triangle equals the number inside the triangle. Reasoning: The center C is the common vertex of the four triangles, so C must be able to combine with the remaining numbers to produce 105, 84, 210, 168. According to the idea of the method draft, the center should take 7; supplementary checking shows that although 3 also divides all four numbers, if C=3, then T·L=35, T·R=28, L·B=70, R·B=56, and the remaining 4, 5, 6, 7 cannot satisfy them simultaneously, so C=3 is not feasible. Therefore C=7. Divide the products of the four triangles all by 7 to obtain the products of two adjacent outer-circle points: T·L=105/7=15, T·R=84/7=12, L·B=210/7=30, R·B=168/7=24. The remaining numbers that can be filled are 3, 4, 5, 6. From T·L=15, T and L are 3, 5; from T·R=12, T and R are 3, 4, so the common T=3, and then L=5, R=4. Then from L·B=30, B=6, and R·B=4·6=24 exactly matches. The one where 168 is located is the lower-right triangle, whose vertices are R, B, C, so the sum of its vertex numbers is 4+6+7=17.

raw_record.question_text: Kai has to insert the numbers 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 into the five circles of the diagram in the following way: The product of the three numbers at the vertices of each triangle has to be equal to the number stated within the triangle. How big is the sum of the numbers at the vertices of the triangle with the number 168?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as five circle positions: top T, left L, center C, right R, bottom B. The four triangles are T-L-C labeled 105, T-R-C labeled 84, L-B-C labeled 210, and R-B-C labeled 168. From the text, assign the numbers 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 once each, with each triangle label equal to the product of its three vertex numbers. Since the center circle C is a vertex of every labeled triangle, C must be one of 3,4,5,6,7 that divides all four products 105, 84, 210, and 168; only 7 works. Then divide each triangle product by 7 to get pair products: T·L=15, T·R=12, L·B=30, R·B=24. Using the remaining numbers 3,4,5,6, solve these pair products: T=3, L=5, R=4, B=6. The triangle labeled 168 has vertices R, B, C, so its sum is 4+6+7=17.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示一个由五个空圆组成的菱形结构，圆的位置分别是上方 T、左方 L、中心 C、右方 R、下方 B。中心圆与四周圆相连，形成四个小三角形：左上三角形 T-L-C 内写着 105，右上三角形 T-R-C 内写着 84，左下三角形 L-B-C 内写着 210，右下三角形 R-B-C 内写着 168。题目要求把 3、4、5、6、7 各用一次填入五个圆中，使每个三角形三个顶点数的乘积等于三角形内的数。

推理：中心 C 是四个三角形的共同顶点，所以 C 必须能与其余数配合产生 105、84、210、168。按方法草稿的思路，中心应取 7；补充检查可知 3 虽然也整除四个数，但若 C=3，则 T·L=35、T·R=28、L·B=70、R·B=56，用剩下的 4、5、6、7 无法同时满足，所以 C=3 不可行。因此 C=7。

把四个三角形的乘积都除以 7，得到相邻外圈两点的乘积：T·L=105/7=15，T·R=84/7=12，L·B=210/7=30，R·B=168/7=24。剩下可填的数是 3、4、5、6。由 T·L=15 得 T 和 L 是 3、5；由 T·R=12 得 T 和 R 是 3、4，所以公共的 T=3，进而 L=5、R=4。再由 L·B=30 得 B=6，并且 R·B=4·6=24 正好符合。

168 所在的是右下三角形，顶点是 R、B、C，因此其顶点数字和为 4+6+7=17。
